note: the dual mode's graded episode, for the verifier's cross-check of the record (tests/verify.py). The graded episode is one mission of the offline grader's fixed hidden set (hidden/seeds.json: twelve sites, ep01..ep12 = h01..h12 in the grader's order), drawn once with OS entropy; the mission (its site package and its pinned noise seed) lives root-only in environment/setup/online/episode.json and h01.tar.xz, where the graded episode's service reads it. seed_sha256 = sha256 of the seed's decimal string.
